title: Apple TV Just Updated Its Selection of 'Bonus' Movies
content:
Starting today, the Apple TV streaming service is offering a new selection of "bonus" movies in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., and some other countries.


While competitors like Netflix offer an extensive catalog of movies from various studios, Apple TV primarily offers its own original films produced by Apple. Over the past few years, however, Apple has offered a "Great Movies Now on Apple TV" section with a limited rotation of iconic movies that subscribers can watch at no additional cost.

The selection changes each month, with the following 13 movies added in the U.S. today:

  • 28 Days Later

  • American Gangster

  • Black Hawk Down

  • Blood Diamond

  • Fallen

  • Fury

  • Going The Distance

  • Good Will Hunting

  • Insomnia

  • Jurassic World

  • Taxi Driver

  • The Girl With the Dragon Tattoo

  • Tropic Thunder

In the U.S., seven more movies remain available as holdovers:

  • A Beautiful Mind

  • A League of Their Own

  • Definitely Maybe

  • I Robot

  • Master and Commander

  • The Rookie

  • The Sixth Sense

The selection varies in other countries. For example, here are the movies available in Canada:

  • Catch Me If You Can

  • Ford v Ferrari

  • Godzilla

  • Inception

  • Jurassic Park

  • Jurassic World

  • Little Miss Sunshine

  • Rocketman

  • Spider-Man: Far From Home

  • Spider-Man: Homecoming

  • The Martian

  • The Proposal

  • The Social Network

  • The Town

  • War of the Worlds

In the Philippines, one of the movies included is Ready Player One.

In the U.S., Apple TV now costs $14.99/month, up from $4.99/month when it launched in 2019.
